Protein and domain annotation resources.name: SCOP
Protein and domain annotation resources.short: The SCOP database, created by manual inspection and abetted by a battery of automated methods, [more...]
Protein and domain annotation resources.long: The SCOP database, created by manual inspection and abetted by a battery of automated methods, aims to provide a detailed and comprehensive description of the structural and evolutionary relationships between all proteins whose structure is known.

Protein and domain annotation resources.name: Pfam
Protein and domain annotation resources.short: The Pfam database is a large collection of protein families, each represented by multiple sequence [more...]
Protein and domain annotation resources.long: The Pfam database is a large collection of protein families, each represented by multiple sequence alignments and hidden Markov models (HMMs).

Protein and domain annotation resources.name: InterPro
Protein and domain annotation resources.short: InterPro provides functional analysis of proteins by classifying them into families and predicting domains and [more...]
Protein and domain annotation resources.long: InterPro provides functional analysis of proteins by classifying them into families and predicting domains and important sites.

Protein and domain annotation resources.name: UniProt
Protein and domain annotation resources.short: The mission of UniProt is to provide the scientific community with a comprehensive, high-quality and [more...]
Protein and domain annotation resources.long: The mission of UniProt is to provide the scientific community with a comprehensive, high-quality and freely accessible resource of protein sequence and functional information.

Protein and domain annotation resources.name: ProKinO
Protein and domain annotation resources.short: The Protein Kinase Ontology (ProKinO), is a protein kinase-specific ontology, which provides a controlled vocabulary [more...]
Protein and domain annotation resources.long: The Protein Kinase Ontology (ProKinO), is a protein kinase-specific ontology, which provides a controlled vocabulary of terms, their hierarchy, and relationships unifying sequence, structure, function, mutation and pathway information on kinases.

Protein and domain annotation resources.name: EMVS
Protein and domain annotation resources.short: EMVS provides different quality and validation scores about cryo-Electron Microscopy maps and their corresponding atomic [more...]
Protein and domain annotation resources.long: EMVS provides different quality and validation scores about cryo-Electron Microscopy maps and their corresponding atomic models.

Protein and domain annotation resources.name: KnotProt
Protein and domain annotation resources.short: The database provides information regarding the presence of knots or slipknots on protein chains and, [more...]
Protein and domain annotation resources.long: The database provides information regarding the presence of knots or slipknots on protein chains and, in the case of their presence, also the type of the knot/slipknot and its position in the chain.

Protein and domain annotation resources.name: KinCore
Protein and domain annotation resources.short: KinCore provides conformational annotations for protein kinase structures.
Protein and domain annotation resources.long: KinCore provides conformational annotations for protein kinase structures.

Protein and domain annotation resources.name: PDBTM
Protein and domain annotation resources.short: PDBTM is the first comprehensive and up-to-date transmembrane protein selection of the PDB.
Protein and domain annotation resources.long: PDBTM is the first comprehensive and up-to-date transmembrane protein selection of the PDB.

Evolutionary conserved sites.name: CATH-FunSites
Evolutionary conserved sites.short: CATH-FunSites are groups of amino acid residues that are evolutionarily conserved within a CATH FunFam, [more...]
Evolutionary conserved sites.long: CATH-FunSites are groups of amino acid residues that are evolutionarily conserved within a CATH FunFam, i.e. proteins sharing the same function and hence, are most likely to be functionally important.

Small-molecule sites.name: ChannelsDB
Small-molecule sites.short: ChannelsDB is a comprehensive and regularly updated resource of channels, pores and tunnels found in [more...]
Small-molecule sites.long: ChannelsDB is a comprehensive and regularly updated resource of channels, pores and tunnels found in biomacromolecules deposited in the Protein Data Bank. As such, it is a unique service for channel-related analyses.

Small-molecule sites.name: canSAR
Small-molecule sites.short: canSAR is an integrated knowledge-base that brings together multidisciplinary data across biology, chemistry, pharmacology, structural [more...]
Small-molecule sites.long: canSAR is an integrated knowledge-base that brings together multidisciplinary data across biology, chemistry, pharmacology, structural biology, cellular networks and clinical annotations, and applies machine learning approaches to provide drug-discovery useful predictions.

Small-molecule sites.name: 3DLigandSite
Small-molecule sites.short: 3DLigandSite is an automated method for the prediction of ligand binding sites.
Small-molecule sites.long: 3DLigandSite is an automated method for the prediction of ligand binding sites.

Small-molecule sites.name: M-CSA
Small-molecule sites.short: M-CSA is a database of enzyme reaction mechanisms. It provides annotation on the protein, catalytic [more...]
Small-molecule sites.long: M-CSA is a database of enzyme reaction mechanisms. It provides annotation on the protein, catalytic residues, cofactors, and the reaction mechanisms of hundreds of enzymes.

Small-molecule sites.name: P2Rank
Small-molecule sites.short: P2Rank is a machine learning based method for prediction of ligand binding sites from protein [more...]
Small-molecule sites.long: P2Rank is a machine learning based method for prediction of ligand binding sites from protein structure.

Small-molecule sites.name: MetalPDB
Small-molecule sites.short: Functional annotation of metal-binding sites in 3D structures
Small-molecule sites.long: Functional annotation of metal-binding sites in 3D structures

Small-molecule sites.name: Covalentizer
Small-molecule sites.short: Covalentizer provides candidates for covalent analogues of small molecules.
Small-molecule sites.long: Covalentizer provides candidates for covalent analogues of small molecules.

Mutations and variations.name: Missense3D
Mutations and variations.short: Missense3D predicts the structural changes introduced by an amino acid substitution and is applicable to [more...]
Mutations and variations.long: Missense3D predicts the structural changes introduced by an amino acid substitution and is applicable to analyse both PDB coordinates and homology-predicted structures.

Mutations and variations.name: FoldX
Mutations and variations.short: FoldX provides a fast and quantitative estimation of the importance of the interactions contributing to [more...]
Mutations and variations.long: FoldX provides a fast and quantitative estimation of the importance of the interactions contributing to the stability of proteins and protein complexes.

Mutations and variations.name: SKEMPI
Mutations and variations.short: SKEMPI provides binding free energy changes upon mutation for structurally resolved protein-protein interactions, including changes [more...]
Mutations and variations.long: SKEMPI provides binding free energy changes upon mutation for structurally resolved protein-protein interactions, including changes in kinetics, as well as enthalpy and entropy changes for a subset of mutations.

Mutations and variations.name: FireProt DB
Mutations and variations.short: FireProt DB provides the stability effects of single-point mutants.
Mutations and variations.long: FireProt DB provides the stability effects of single-point mutants.
Mutations and variations.annotation_type: Effects of mutations on protein stabilities

Mutations and variations.name: FrustratometeR
Mutations and variations.short: FrustratometeR provides the Delta Frustration between the native and the mutated variant for the PDBs where the mutations are located.
Mutations and variations.long: FrustratometeR provides the Delta Frustration between the native and the mutated variant for the PDBs where the mutations are located.

Protein binding sites.name: 14-3-3-Pred
Protein binding sites.short: 14-3-3-Pred is a webserver that predicts 14-3-3-binding sites in proteins by combining predictions from three [more...]
Protein binding sites.long: 14-3-3-Pred is a webserver that predicts 14-3-3-binding sites in proteins by combining predictions from three different classifiers: ANN, PSSM SVM, as wll as a consensus predictor. 14-3-3-Pred provides prediction scores as well as information on the phosphorylation state of the respective Ser/Thr.

Protein binding sites.name: AKID
Protein binding sites.short: Predictions of phosphorylation sites for kinases in target proteins.
Protein binding sites.long: Predictions of phosphorylation sites for kinases in target proteins.

Protein binding sites.name: CaMKinet
Protein binding sites.short: CaMKinet is a Calcium/Calmodulin-dependent protein kinases (CaMKs) and their substrates database. CaMKs and their allies [more...]
Protein binding sites.long: CaMKinet is a Calcium/Calmodulin-dependent protein kinases (CaMKs) and their substrates database. CaMKs and their allies constitute a large family of Serine/Threonine kinases.

Protein binding sites.name: Scop3P
Protein binding sites.short: Scop3P provides Human phosphorylation sites identified by re-processing large scale public proteomics datasets.
Protein binding sites.long: Scop3P provides Human phosphorylation sites identified by re-processing large scale public proteomics datasets.

Biophysical parameters.name: DynaMine
Biophysical parameters.short: DynaMine is a fast predictor of protein backbone dynamics using only sequence information as input.
Biophysical parameters.long: DynaMine is a fast predictor of protein backbone dynamics using only sequence information as input.

Biophysical parameters.name: POPSCOMP
Biophysical parameters.short: POPSCOMP is a method to analyse interactions between individual complex components of proteins and/or nucleic [more...]
Biophysical parameters.long: POPSCOMP is a method to analyse interactions between individual complex components of proteins and/or nucleic acids by calculating the solvent accessible surface area (SASA) buried upon complex formation.

Biophysical parameters.name: Arpeggio
Biophysical parameters.short: Calculations of interatomic interactions in protein structures
Biophysical parameters.long: Calculations of interatomic interactions in protein structures

Biophysical parameters.name: COSPI-Depth
Biophysical parameters.short: Server for computing/predicting depth, cavity sizes, ligand binding sites and pKa
Biophysical parameters.long: Server for computing/predicting depth, cavity sizes, ligand binding sites and pKa

Biophysical parameters.short: Sequence-based predictions of the residues that start to fold independently in proteins
Biophysical parameters.long: Sequence-based predictions of the residues that start to fold independently in proteins

Biophysical parameters.name: MobiDB
Biophysical parameters.short: MobiDB provides consensus intrinsic disorder predictions.
Biophysical parameters.long: MobiDB provides consensus intrinsic disorder predictions.

Biophysical parameters.name: WEBnm@
Biophysical parameters.short: WEBnm@ provides flexibility prediction in the form of the normalized displacement of each amino acid [more...]
Biophysical parameters.long: WEBnm@ provides flexibility prediction in the form of the normalized displacement of each amino acid in the structure. The displacement is predicted by performing Normal mode analysis (NMA) using an elastic network model (ENM) on each single PDB file. Note that only the first 200 lowest-frequency normal modes are used to calculate the displacement.
